controls.label: birthday
controls.inline: async()=>{const input=make('input');input.type='date';input.value=D.parse(birthday.value)?.iso||'';input.max=D.today().iso;input.setAttribute('aria-label','选择生日');const action=await UI.sheet({title:'你的生日',content:input,actions:[{label:'使用这个生日',value:'apply'},{label:'不填写生日',value:'clear'}]});if(action==='clear')birthday.value='';if(action==='apply'){const date=D.parse(input.value);if(!date||date.time>D.today().time){UI.fieldError(birthday,'请选择有效的过去日期');return;}birthday.value=date.iso;}}

controls.label: 保存资料
controls.inline: ()=>{if(reading){UI.toast('头像正在读取，请稍候');return;}const nickname=document.querySelector('#nickname').value.trim();if(!nickname){UI.fieldError(document.querySelector('#nickname'),'请填写昵称');return;}UI.busy(document.querySelector('#save'),'保存中…',()=>{if(UI.failNext('settings-profile'))throw new Error('个人资料未保存，请重试');const next={...saved,...Object.fromEntries(fields.map(key=>[key,document.querySelector('#'+key).value.trim()])),avatar,aliases:[...new Set([...(Array.isArray(saved.aliases)?saved.aliases:[]),saved.nickname])],updatedAt:Date.now()};if(!UI.write('dujia-profile',next))return false;leave.commit();return UI.go('m06-p01.html',{force:true});});}
